paragraphs: (Maacah daughter of Abishalom, [I Kings 15:2](https://www.sefaria.org/I_Kings.15.2).) Rabbi Natan bar Abishalom, [Berakhot 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.22a.6). Rabbi Shimon bar Abishalom, [Berakhot 7b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.7b.13).[^1]

notes.text: Both consulted Berakhot passages have ben Abishalom where Hyman gives bar. These are separate patronymic notices.
